---
# Page title that appears at the top
title: "Projects + Blog"

# Listing configuration - tells Quarto how to display blog posts
listing:
  contents: posts      # folder where blog posts are stored
  type: grid               # display style: grid, default, or table
  sort: "date desc"        # sort posts by date, newest first
  categories: true         # show category tags for filtering posts

# Draft status - IMPORTANT!
# draft: true  = page won't be published (hidden from site)
# draft: false = page will be published (visible on site)
draft: false
---
